Calm handover a useful reminder for new travelers
Please read this before you travel
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers should know that careful preparation helps companion animals move through Aurelia Skyways with less strain and fewer delays. Our team asks you to review your papers, carrier needs, and feeding plans before arrival so that the journey begins in a calm and orderly way.

Please keep your pet close to the guidance provided at check-in and speak up early if anything feels uncertain. <<FACT F076>> For cat travel, please also make sure the health certificate is current before you come to the desk. <<FACT F079>> We understand that each pet may need a different kind of support, and our supervisors will listen carefully when you raise a concern.

This service treats every journey as a shared responsibility between travelers and the Companion Animal Travel Desk. If you are preparing for travel with a rabbit, a cat, or another companion animal, please arrive with the documents and carrier arranged as directed, and keep your pet calm and secure through the process.

For personal help, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
